scripts.dev: echo 'Run in two terminals: npm run dev:web  and  npm run dev:server'
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:server
scripts.test:unit: TZ=America/Los_Angeles tsx --test web/src/**/*.test.ts && TZ=UTC tsx --test web/src/**/*.test.ts && TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati tsx --test web/src/**/*.test.ts
